survey: A single brown leather cowboy boot in three-quarter side view, toe pointing right and slightly toward the viewer, floating with no ground drawn. The tall shaft rises from the foot and leans slightly. Its top has a scalloped rim with stitching, and a small patch of tan lining shows at the front-right, so the top is seen a little from above. A stitched collar seam circles the ankle where the shaft meets the foot. The foot runs to a pointed toe on a dark brown sole of even thickness, seen almost level from the side with none of its top ledge showing. At the back, a block Cuban heel with slanted faces is seen from the side and a little from the front; its base sits slightly lower than the forefoot sole, which reads as normal toe spring. A gold spur sits at the heel. Its arm is a straight horizontal bar lying on the boot's side and ending in a rounded tip. The star rowel is seen face-on, which is correct because its wheel turns in the boot's lengthwise plane.

errors.where: Top opening of the boot shaft
errors.what: The opening is not drawn as an ellipse matching the round shaft. Most of the top, from the back to the left side, is a closed, rounded, dome-like rim, and only a small notch of lining shows at the front-right. A round tube seen slightly from above, as the visible lining says it is, should show one oval opening across the full width of the shaft, with the back rim seen over the inside and the front rim in front of it.

errors.where: Gold spur arm (yoke) at the heel
errors.what: The spur arm is a straight flat bar lying on the side of the boot and stopping in a rounded tip. It does not curve around the round heel. A yoke that wraps the heel should show as a curved band following the boot's surface and turning out of sight around the back and the far side.

errors.where: Ankle collar seam compared with the top rim
errors.what: The ankle seam is an almost straight slanted line, while the top rim curves as if seen from above. Under one camera placed above the boot, a ring lower down on the boot should bow downward toward the viewer at least as much as the top rim. Here the lower ring reads as seen level and the top as seen from above.

fix: Cowboy boot in three-quarter side view from one consistent camera slightly above the boot. The shaft top is one clear oval opening across the full width of the round shaft: the back rim shows above the tan lining inside, and the front rim curves in front of it. The stitched ankle seam is a ring around the boot that bows gently downward toward the viewer, matching the curve of the top rim. The gold spur's arm is a curved band that wraps around the round heel and disappears around the back, with the star rowel at the back in the boot's lengthwise plane.
